rv.q: McCollum’s performance is among the most spectacular to be experienced currently on the New York stage.
Actor Wade McCollum presents the kind of rarely seen one man tour de force that reminds us how transformational theater can be.
McCollum’s performance keeps the action taut and consistently shines a bright light on a remarkable life.
His personal charm and rapport with the audience also makes this a pleasurable experience.
Singing, stripping, and hilariously vamping an unsuspecting male in the audience, McCollum is the hardest-working woman in show business.

cn.t: Wade McCollum delivers a stunning, hardworking performance as forgotten LGBTQ trailblazer Kenneth Marlowe in this tour de force solo show, though the production loses some momentum in its later passages.
